name: base3_teacher
_comment: teacher-engine comparison on the SAME stack and the SAME sign-off sizing as base3 (base_case = base3: sizing, kernel data and weights are read from <root>/base3). Only the engine differs from configs/base3.json: the 6x256 teacher SKN, direct kernel look-up, M = 64 output times. Results go to <root>/base3_teacher. The PDE-residual ablation uses this file with --out-name ablation_pde.
